name: Keystone Boys State
org: The American Legion Department of Pennsylvania
city: Pennsylvania (held at Messiah University, Mechanicsburg, in 2027)
what_you_do: Spend a week in a pretend state called Keystone. You run for office and debate bills.
grades: Finished 11th grade, with at least one semester of high school left
who_can_apply: Boys who live in Pennsylvania, have finished their junior year and have at least one semester of high school left. You cannot have gone to a Boys State before. Leadership, character and school service count.
pay_detail: No pay. American Legion posts and the Department pay the fees, so little or no cost to the family.
deadline_text: The home page and the Legion page still say to apply for 2027, but one page on the site says 2027 registration has closed, as of Nov 4, 2026. No closing date is posted. Session: June 20 to June 26, 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form from the Apply link on the Keystone Boys State site before you arrive. Posts also sponsor students; use the Legion post locator on the Pennsylvania Legion page.
notes: Boys only. A matching Girls State program is run by the American Legion Auxiliary, not this one. The site disagrees on whether 2027 registration is open. To confirm, email kbsapplication@gmail.com or call 717-730-9100 x 123.
